title: MS-21 approved notification acceptance criteria
content: The approved launch scope enables email notifications by default, excludes SMS collection, and requires explicit confirmation before saving the preference.

title: PM confirms email-only launch scope in Slack
content: For MS-21, launch with email notifications only. Do not request a phone number or expose SMS controls. Keep the confirmation step so users understand when the preference is saved.

title: Claude verifies the implementation needs no SMS dependency
content: Claude reviewed the proposed MS-21 scope and found that email-only preferences can use the existing account settings path. Adding SMS would require phone verification, consent tracking, and a messaging provider, so those controls should remain absent from this change.
